title: Research sprint goal: redact catches every common secret shape
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.

gates.question: Where do the sprint's findings live in the kb: a new article security/secret-shapes-in-text (priority P2), or added to an existing article?

notes: Research 2026-10-17: new article security/secret-shapes-in-text (kb/public/security/secret-shapes-in-text.md), gaps under '## security/secret-shapes-in-text' in kb/public/_gaps.md. Knowledge by item: BG-w5d2mvwz (assignments) reads the Connection strings, AWS and detect-secrets facts: password/passwd/pwd/secret/api_key names are a community list (UNK: no official list), PWD and Password are SqlClient keywords (case-insensitive), a quoted value may hold ';', Microsoft's own detector skips a placeholder value (*, <...>), an AWS secret access key holds '/' so the value must not stop there. BG-d2ezi7qd (headers, URL, key blocks) reads the Authorization, URL userinfo and Private key blocks facts: Bearer/Basic take any token68 (no length or entropy floor, scheme case-insensitive, Proxy-Authorization the same), Basic is base64 of user:password, userinfo password ends at the closing '@' and may be percent-encoded, key labels PRIVATE KEY, ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY, RSA PRIVATE KEY, OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY with the body on the lines up to the END line. Not researched (gaps): Digest, vendor private-token headers, cookies.
